Usage:  circleci runner init [<namespace>/<name>] [flags]

Flags:
      --description string   description of the resource class
  -f, --force                accept the runner terms without a confirmation prompt
  -h, --help                 help for init
      --jq string            Process values from the response using jq syntax
      --json                 Output as JSON
      --org string           Organization slug (e.g. gh/myorg) or UUID; defaults to git remote
      --platform string      where the agent will run: debian|rpm|macos|windows|docker|kubernetes (prompts when unset)
